title: Eliphaz's First Speech and Nightly Vision
description: Eliphaz from Teman speaks up and reminds Job how he once guided and strengthened others, but now collapses under his own trial. He claims that the innocent do not perish, while those who sow evil reap disaster, illustrated by the fate of the lion. Then he recounts a frightening nighttime vision in which a spirit glided past his face and a voice asked whether a human can be righteous before God—for even angels He finds faulty, how much more those who dwell in houses of clay.
